_comment: Edit this, not the code. Models are Claude Code aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) or full model ids. max_cost_usd and worker_budget_usd are the SDK's local token-cost ESTIMATE at API list prices, not money billed on a subscription — useful only as a relative throttle. On a subscription the real limit is your plan's usage cap; max_cycles is the ceiling that matters. on_quota=rotate expects ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to point at the OmniRoute gateway: a usage limit then re-issues the call so the gateway serves it from the next account in its pool. Rotation is skipped automatically when the run is pointed straight at Anthropic.
goal:
Finish Phase 2, then stop after one slice of Phase 3. Do not attempt Phase 3 in full, and do not start Phases 4, 5 or 6 — they have no design spec and there is no budget for them.

PHASE 2 — remaining (design frozen in design/components.md §13-§17, layouts.md §8-§10, interactions.md §10-§12):
1. Finish the conflict UI: needs-attention row and conflict panel (P2-T15 was mid-flight), then conflict preview and apply, reusing the drag-drop drop-preview vocabulary per the spec — it needs no new renderer.
2. Protected and low-energy time windows: the TimeWindow editor, and scheduling that never places into a protected window.
3. The menu bar extra: status item, next-up popover, its empty state and its 'you are late' state, with Done / Snooze / Open actions.
4. Snooze: moves the item and shows where it moved TO, per the brief's no-guilt rule.
5. Then Phase 2 is done: populate screenshots/2/ with an INDEX.md and have DA review the captures against the spec.

THEN ONE PHASE 3 SLICE, and nothing more of Phase 3:
6. ICS subscription import only — paste a URL, poll it, import read-only events. This is how the real university timetable gets into the app, and it is the point where Kadence becomes usable daily. Phase 3 has no design coverage, so DA must spec this slice before CA builds it; keep that spec pass scoped to ICS import alone.
Out of scope: Moodle REST, CalDAV, TravelTimeProvider/MapKit, work items, time logging, notifications, mail triage, the planning assistant.

When the ICS slice is verified and a real timetable renders, report PHASE_DONE and stop.
